# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take security seriously and appreciate your efforts to disclose vulnerabilities responsibly.

### Supported Versions

| Branch | Supported? | Version |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `main` | ✅ Yes     | latest  |
| others | ❌ No      | -       |

### Disclosure Policy

* Do NOT discuss publicly (issues, social media)
* Email: security@mirema-hotel.com (PGP key available on request)
* Include: Description, impact, steps to repro, affected versions

We aim to acknowledge within 48h, fix in 7-30 days, release patch.

### Rewards
Security issues may qualify for swag/thanks (case-by-case).

No parallel exploitation or public disclosure during process.

Thank you for helping keep Mirema Hotel safe! 🔒

*Last updated: 2024*
